answer: At each epoch's vertex, votes are weighted by bonded stake times unique-task history, so an attacker forging a thousand sybils must fund and sustain real work on every identity, paying linear cost for sublinear influence and risking slashing that burns each bond to ash. Require each agent to stake a bond that decays like an ember unless refreshed by verified work, and let reputation slot weight ride the rising tide of that reputation rather than raw account count. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
